profile.name: xArm协作机械臂
profile.description: xArm协作机械臂是一种多关节机器人，用于实验室自动化中的样品转运、定位、抓取和重复操作任务。该设备可提供笛卡尔位置、关节状态、运行模式、告警、温度以及电机相关状态等运行信息，适合自动化操作与过程监测。
profile.description_en: The xArm collaborative robotic arm is a multi-joint robot used in laboratory automation for sample transfer, positioning, gripping, and repetitive handling tasks. The device can report Cartesian position, joint status, operating mode, alarms, temperature, and motor-related states, making it suitable for automated operations and process monitoring.
